Which of the three would you wear first?

posts.caption:
One cream knit polo, three evenings. In Milan it goes tucked into navy pleated trousers with a brown belt and suede loafers. Tucked or untucked, which one is you?

#mensstyle #italianstyle #knitpolo #classicmenswear #capsulewardrobe
